impacts.text: The bundler treats this as an internal account failure rather than a clean signature rejection, leading to the Account or Factory being penalized, throttled, or outright banned by mempool validators.
This enables a trivial Denial-of-Service (DoS) and griefing vector.
The bundler's reputation scoring will penalize the wallet
effectively blocking legitimate operations from being processed by the standard ERC-4337 infrastructure.

ambiguities: Transaction reverts entirely on invalid-length or high-S malleable signature (stated in e_a4d9c778d454_0026) is a mechanism/condition rather than a distinct harmful outcome.
